summary: TORM plc filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release dated November 3, 2026, updating on shareholder engagement after its April 15, 2026 AGM. At that meeting the Directors' Remuneration Report, Remuneration Policy and off-market share buyback authority (Buyback Contract B) each drew more than 20% votes against the Board's recommendation. In line with UK Corporate Governance Code Provision 4, the Board consulted dissenting holders, who cited remuneration structure, incentive safeguards, governance and buyback process transparency rather than opposition to capital returns. The Board will evaluate the CEO bonus and submit a revised Remuneration Policy at the 2027 AGM. No transaction terms; governance follow-up only.
